title: My Sites: Your sites title row carries Add sites at the table's right edge, and the table fits the panel without sideways scroll
steps: S1: run packages/site/tracy-my-sites/test/e2e/table-fits-panel.test.mjs (headless Chromium, the built My Sites bundle).
expect: S1: no sideways scroll at the panel width the frame opens My Sites at; Add sites sits on the title row at the table right edge, full width, and wraps without overflow when narrow.
